text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"This is... quite a unique-looking
dish, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~...!
The restaurant's interior was eccentric enough,
but the food is even more... how should I put it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Right in front of me,
a hot pot dish as black as tar
was bubbling and boiling away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all started in the first place with some words
Mejiro Ardan said on our way back from going out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I'm going out to a restaurant with Fine-san after this.
Would you care to join us, if it's no trouble?"
choice_data_list: Are you sure? I'd love to!
Are you sure? I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where I was brought was an utterly eerie shop.
The signboard read—
"Dark Creative Cuisine: Yamitaro."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san.
Thank you once again for treating me
to ramen the other day."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As a thank-you, I tried looking for a restaurant
that would leave a lasting impression, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"You're right, I'm sure we'll make wonderful memories!
I mean, I've never been to a shop like this before!"
choice_data_list: (It might be her first time, sure, but still...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that is wonderful to hear...
Truth be told, I have rarely ever eaten out with friends before.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then let's have a blast today!
Hey you, there are plates over there,
could you serve the hot pot for us?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please be careful.
It feels like inside this pot, there's—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flap flap flap flap!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
――There seems to be some kind of tentacles inside...
I'm sorry, it seems my warning was too late.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why are the ingredients in the hot pot moving...!?
Terrified, I somehow managed to serve the hot pot,
and everyone received their plates.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
Well then, down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I timidly brought the chopsticks to my mouth,
what met my senses was pure "chaos."
Is this seafood? Meat? A dessert?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It feels as if every flavor in the world has been crammed into my mouth. My tongue is numb.
Is this... the darkness—!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh?! ...How fascinating~!
Amazing! I've never tasted food like this before!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion seemed unexpectedly cheerful about it.
However, this flavor was... After struggling for a while,
just as I was about to put down my chopsticks—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I see, so this is 'Dark Creative Cuisine'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What jumped into view was
Mejiro Ardan setting down her bowl,
having finished every single drop of soup...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I do feel it's rather unique.
Like, it feels closer to Chinese herbal medicine or health foods,
something along those lines—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still, it is a familiar taste to me.
Indeed, before I knew it, I had finished it all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still, it is a familiar taste to me.
Indeed, before I knew it, I had finished it all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Dependable, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um, hehe, I'm sorry.
I'm just not used to hearing that, so it surprised me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that...
makes taking all those various-flavored medicines
feel well worth it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I suppose that means strange flavors have their own unique charms!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Hehe, an adventure like this
might not be so bad once in a while.♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of it as herbal medicine,
I felt like I could actually manage it!
Gripping my chopsticks once more, I dug in—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I felt like... I had grown just a little bit tougher.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since they went out of their way to treat me,
how could I leave anything behind!
With that in mind, she picked up her chopsticks once more...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um, you're looking rather pale...
Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please don't force yourself.
The rest of us can finish it all
by ourselves, so...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm,
you gradually get used to it as you eat.
Still, it's definitely an unforgettable taste...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, that was quick.
Did you take a liking to it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"There are second helpings too! By the way, for the finale,
looks like you can choose between saffron rice and jade noodles.
Which would you like?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Well then, shall the two of us enjoy the rest, Fine-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, Mejiro Ardan was already working on
her second bowl with a completely straight face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...
Today really showed me an unexpectedly
resilient side of Mejiro Ardan...
